text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited at all times on the south side of Manor Road East at its intersection with Redpath Avenue. In conjunction with pavement marking treatments for the intersection of Manor Road East and Redpath Avenue, the proposed prohibition will eliminate the 10-minute and 1-hour parking spaces within the intersection to enhance driver awareness of the all-way stop controls at this intersection, and will result in the loss of four on-street parking spaces.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Manor Road East, between a point 24 metres west of Servington Crescent (east intersection) and a point 32.5 metres further west. 2. Rescinded the existing parking for a maximum period of 10-minutes in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Manor Road East, between a point 24 metres west of Servington Crescent (east intersection) and a point 23 metres further west. 3. Authorized the existing parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Manor Road East, between Redpath Avenue and a point 56.5 metres west of Servington Crescent (east intersection). 4.
